description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for WidgetsBundleEntity, including custom query methods for searching, retrieving, and managing widget bundles in a database.

classes.name: WidgetsBundleRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for WidgetsBundleEntity with custom search and retrieval methods.

methods.name: findWidgetsBundleByTenantIdAndAlias
methods.description: Finds a widget bundle by tenant ID and alias.

methods.name: findSystemWidgetsBundles
methods.description: Retrieves system widget bundles with optional text search, paginated.

methods.name: findSystemWidgetsBundlesFullSearch
methods.description: Performs a full search for system widget bundles with complex filtering, paginated.

methods.name: findTenantWidgetsBundlesByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves widget bundles for a specific tenant with optional text search, paginated.

methods.name: findAllTenantWidgetsBundlesByTenantIds
methods.description: Retrieves widget bundles for multiple tenants with optional text search, paginated.

methods.name: findAllTenantWidgetsBundlesByTenantIdsFullSearch
methods.description: Performs a full search for multiple tenants' widget bundles with filtering, paginated.

methods.name: findFirstByTenantIdAndTitle
methods.description: Finds the first widget bundle matching tenant ID and title.

methods.name: getExternalIdById
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for a widget bundle by its internal ID.

methods.name: findByTenantAndImageUrl
methods.description: Finds widget bundles by tenant ID and image URL with limit.

methods.name: findByImageUrl
methods.description: Finds widget bundles by image URL with limit.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of widget bundle fields after a given ID.

methods.name: findSystemOrTenantWidgetsBundlesByIdIn
methods.description: Finds widget bundles by a list of IDs, considering tenant and system tenant IDs.
